title: Design System: Nuttie Living Growth Mark

display.purpose: A short page statement or diary invitation; never a promotional hero.

title.purpose: Screen title, date, or focal value.

body.purpose: Instructions and explanations that must survive Simplified Chinese wrapping.

caption.purpose: Units, provenance, sync state, and supporting metadata.

shadows.name: ambient-small
shadows.purpose: Quiet lift for a feature surface; not used on every row.

shadows.name: feature-lift
shadows.purpose: Transient sheet or focal surface that must sit above the page.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: A bounded growth-ring or surface state change; never a random identity change.

motion.name: press-feedback
motion.purpose: Opacity/tonal response to press, hover, or keyboard focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove non-essential movement when the platform requests reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: narrow-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column forms and stacked metric groups.

breakpoints.name: expanded-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column field rows when each field retains a readable minimum width.

breakpoints.name: rail
breakpoints.purpose: Switch from bottom navigation to the expanded rail and wider hero.

breakpoints.name: wide-review
breakpoints.purpose: Give the centered content and review panes room without stretching text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear next action for saving or adding a record.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #A85D3F; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 15px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .88; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: .76; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4E88A5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A low-risk alternative that keeps the primary action visually rare.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #E3DBCE; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFDF8; color: #A85D3F; font: 600 13px/18px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out, opacity 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F5EFE6; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: .76; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4E88A5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A native-shaped field for facts that can remain incomplete without losing the draft.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; color: #252A26; font: 600 13px/18px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #E3DBCE; border-radius: 10px; background: #F5EFE6; color: #252A26; font: 400 15px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #7B837B; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(78,136,165,.28); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #4E88A5; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: The same destination vocabulary in a phone bar or expanded rail.
components.html: 日记
components.css: .ds-nav-active { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #E5F0E7; color: #3F7C59; font: 600 13px/18px system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-nav-active:hover { opacity: .82; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4E88A5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metric Band
components.description: A compact fact with unit and provenance hint, suitable for a phone stack or wide grid.
components.html: 今日摄入未记录添加餐食后显示
components.css: .ds-metric { min-height: 116px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #E3DBCE; border-radius: 16px; background: #FFFDF8; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; color: #252A26; } .ds-metric-marker { width: 24px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: #A85D3F; } .ds-metric-label, .ds-metric small { color: #5F6860; font: 500 12px/16px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric strong { font: 700 24px/30px system-ui, sans-serif; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-metric small { margin-top: auto; color: #7B837B; }

components.name: Growth Mark
components.description: The deterministic stateful mark that makes today's small records visible as continuity.
components.html: 42%正在成长
components.css: .ds-growth { width: 188px; height: 188px; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #252A26; } .ds-growth svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-growth strong, .ds-growth span { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-growth strong { margin-top: -4px; font: 700 28px/34px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-growth span { margin-top: 34px; margin-left: -42px; color: #5F6860; font: 600 12px/16px system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Nuttie turns small, repeatable records into a trustworthy daily picture. A bounded growth ring carries continuity across diary, trends, sign-in, and settings; semantic colors and explicit state copy keep the mark supportive rather than judgmental. The system is warm and precise, with paper-toned surfaces, native type, measured corners, and a rail that opens the same work on larger screens.
keyCharacteristics: One deterministic mark, four named states
Facts, provenance, missingness, and sync status remain readable
Bottom navigation on phones; rail and wider review topology at 768px+

rules.name: Meaning Before Color
rules.body: Every important state is named in text or structure; color reinforces it.

rules.name: Rare Chestnut
rules.body: Chestnut belongs to the next useful action and the identity mark, not to broad decoration.

rules.name: Flat By Default
rules.body: Use tonal layers and hairlines first; reserve shadows for a focal or transient layer.

rules.name: Native Scale
rules.body: Let platform shaping and text enlargement win over a fixed web-only scale.

dos: Do keep the growth mark's geometry stable while its bounded state changes.
Do make the first viewport show today's facts and one reachable add action.
Do preserve text alternatives for charts, states, and missing values.
Do switch topology by width instead of stretching a phone screen.
donts: Don't use gradients, glow, bokeh, or decorative blobs.
Don't turn progress into a score, streak punishment, or medical conclusion.
Don't hide core actions behind hover, gestures, or sub-44px targets.
Don't silently replace missing values with zero or overwrite a revision conflict.
